## About TimerRoot

TimerRoot — POSIX CPU-timer UAF (CVE-2026-98260) → fake cred →
KernelSU late-load ("Jailbreak mode").

Signed with the release keystore; the workflow refuses to
publish without it. Requires a running Shizuku shell
service (ADB / wireless debugging). One full run per boot — the
app enforces this itself; reboot before every run.
